The '''Shattered Prison''' was the name given to the southern edge of [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Prison/Legends|prison]] yard along the cliff was ravaged by [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]], and the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Aurora Cannon]] was located in the eastern corner.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shattered Prison appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
